I checked the logs from this day and it seems someone pressed the Emegency Stop button:
I checked the charger now and it's working, someone must've unpressed the button to make it work again.
I will proceed to close the ticket since the answer has been given and the problem is resolved.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead!
Best regards,
Francisco
